comments.body: Thanks! Default `wrap_style = "flow"` still shows the number-only row from #783: flow passes the gutter spans to `wrap_spans`, so the row is never blank. Only gutter mode and side-by-side are fixed. Could you cover flow and add a render-level test?

Thanks, you're right: flow wrapping passes the gutter spans through `wrap_spans`, so a word that fits a fresh row but not beside the gutter left a row with only the line number. The new commit treats the gutter as non-content in flow mode, in both the renderer and the row-height calculation, so the word is broken across rows like an over-long one. Added a render-level test (`should_not_leave_a_gutter_only_row_when_flow_wrapped_word_does_not_fit_beside_the_gutter`, default flow style, with and without relative line numbers) plus a unit test for the wrapper.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
